# No command line appears anywhere in the thread; the reporter names only DXC
# 1.6.2104.52 and "SPIR-V output". ps_6_0 is chosen because it is the oldest
# profile that can express the shader, which keeps old releases probeable
# (SKILL.md: target the oldest profile that still shows the symptom).
# No -Fo, so dxc disassembles the module to stdout, which is what the predicate
# reads.
-T ps_6_0 -E PS_bright_pass -spirv repro.hlsl
